rule: Do not run every method blindly.
Run the methods capable of changing the active classifier state.

response.serialization: Sorted object keys using JavaScript UTF-16 order; JSON.stringify primitive encoding; array order preserved; schema admits only integer numbers. Versioned custom format, not a JCS conformance claim.
response.adoption: Blocked: requires a separate trusted proof and approval gate.
response.adapters: Adapters supply declared sources; this module does not retrieve or authenticate them.
response.compatibility: Separate universal contract; does not replace the Python proof-gate packet or registry.
response.authorization: Pure read-only function; no dispatch, persistence, external action, or automatic promotion.

boot_sequence: Normalize supplied records into declared typed structures and analytical questions. Never invent missing sources or method inputs.
Call route_problem; existing business_logic_sweep also accepts routing, or context set to UMTB4: followed by JSON of this input_schema.
Read get_method_ark or get_method_catalog for bounded model requirements. No evaluator runs automatically.

For controlled atomic variations call review_atomic_variants, or supply atomic_review in this input. PLAN is the default; EXECUTE_SUPPLIED_MODELS must be explicit. Read get_universal_contract.atomic_review first.

Use render_output after analysis, preserving every claim state. If unavailable, supply presentation in the routing input through existing sweep context. Use method_lookup for Method Ark discovery through the same path.
universal_router.missing_evidence_policy: No typed frame means BLOCKED and zero activations. Country comparisons do not by themselves activate money, replay or settlement.
universal_router.evidence_boundary: References are caller declarations, not source authentication or authorization. REQUIRED/ACTIVE means structurally selected, not a finding.
universal_router.child_gate_boundary: Only the question-specific default lenses activate; additional unsupported lenses remain BLOCKED. Registry coverage is not applicability.

atomic_review.atom_unit: One declared variable/value, with identity, source, classifiers, parent, dependencies, falsifier and expected record.
atomic_review.identity_policy: Caller-supplied native atom IDs and typed subject identities are preserved. Test variants do not mint canonical classifiers.
atomic_review.operator_execution_scope: Finite supplied atom states; model projections are explicitly bound by JSON pointers. Transform labels do not imply formal solver completeness.
atomic_review.method_packet_key_value_normalization: The original declaration LEGAL EFFECT CLAIMED? = NO is represented by key LEGAL EFFECT CLAIMED? with value NO.

reduction_identity.identity_vs_sha256: Native heading calls this a reduction hash, but the declared MMR string is an identity format; it is not a SHA256 digest algorithm.
reduction_identity.runtime_receipt_rule: Original object/child/MMR identities and declared source-version namespaces remain distinct from computed source, base-state, model, run, or artifact SHA256 digests. A digest never establishes source authenticity or occurrence of an event.

atomic_review.method_discovery: get_method_ark catalog_layer selects IMPLEMENTED, METHOD_HOOKS, FRAMEWORK_OPERATORS, REDUCTION_METHODS, TRANSFORMATIONS or MIRRORS. Limit 1–5; follow next_offset.
atomic_review.no_material_gain_stop: No fixed maximum depth; stop if the split cannot change any material coordinate, proof gap, or record-acquisition strategy.
atomic_review.invariants: A newly violated supplied invariant creates a MODEL_COUNTEREXAMPLE_CANDIDATE; native proof and impact remain separate.

review_bridge.evidence: Use get_universal_contract, then validate_evidence_packet to check exact versions, subject references, spans and dependencies. Structural PASS does not establish truth or legal applicability.
